newsitem.title: IRELAND: Soccer-Ireland squad for Welsh game named.
newsitem.headline: Soccer-Ireland squad for Welsh game named.

text.p: Ireland manager Mick McCarthy on Tuesday named Derby County's veteran defender Paul McGrath in his 20-man squad for the friendly international against Wales in Cardiff on February 11.
McGrath, 37, last played for Ireland when he won a record 82nd cap in the 2-0 defeat by the Czech Republic in Prague last April.

There was also a call up for Leeds United full-back Gary Kelly who hasn't played for Ireland since the European Championship qualifier against Holland at Anfield in November 1995 because of injury and a dip in form.
DEFENDERS- Denis Irwin, Phil Babb, Paul McGrath, Terry Phelan, Jeff Kenna, Gary Breen, Kenny Cunningham, Gary Kelly.
MIDFIELDERS- Steve Staunton, Roy Keane, Mark Kennedy, Alan McLoughlin, Jason McAteer, John Sheridan.
STRIKERS- Tony Cascarino, Alan Moore, David Connolly, David Kelly.
